decision: accepted for bounded API35 screenshot capture-state evidence
scope: Independent inspection of all 32 original PNGs individually; not broad vertical-layout, usability, linguistic or release acceptance.
head: 66c39ca345ef7bc8c5fe1da8ce64cb872c3a0e88

fixed_failure.observation: Popup is visibly open, unlike the retained previous attempt. Difference is actual format-list pixels, not merely an incidental clock/status change.

limits: Horizontal scrolling leaves partial/offscreen labels and neighboring columns; this review does not certify absence of clipping.
Manchu landscape JPEG slider thumb is partially clipped at the right viewport edge; complete thumb visibility and full-range interaction are not established.
Shown glyph/emoji appearance does not certify wording, grammar, language quality, all strings or all glyphs.
Screenshots demonstrate captured states; they do not independently prove all actions or comprehensive usability. Installed test assertions have their separately verified scope.
API35 emulator only; API30 and physical devices are not certified.
The earlier failed pair remains a failed historical attempt; this acceptance applies only to the bound new artifact.
